title: CrowdStrike Shares Fall 10% After a $44 Billion Zscaler Deal Despite an Earnings Beat and Raised Guidance
content: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., explains why shares of CrowdStrike (NASDAQ: CRWD) fell about 10% on Monday, November 23, while most tech stocks rallied. The trigger was a proposed acquisition of Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) for about $44 billion, announced the same morning. The sell-off came despite a strong report. CrowdStrike posted revenue growth of 28.3% against expectations of 23.9%, and EPS of $0.34 against $0.31. It also raised full-year guidance. Bleeker points to the deal instead: Zscaler's wide product line may be hard to integrate into CrowdStrike's platform, and the roughly 34% premium arrives when cybersecurity stocks are richly valued. Zscaler shares rose about 16%, while CrowdStrike is now down 26% from its recent highs. Bleeker lays out both cases. The bull case is that cybersecurity budgets must rise as companies patch systems, with outages at Apple and others as examples. The bear case is that frontier AI models may become the center of cyber defense, which raises questions about what companies like CrowdStrike offer. Expect choppy trading in these shares while investors sort that out.

title: Palantir Rips 10% to Lead Software Stocks. Cloudflare and ServiceNow Also Join ‘Jensen Rally’
content: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., says Jensen Huang's return to NVIDIA is lifting technology stocks on Monday. The NASDAQ was up more than 7% as of 1:30 p.m. Eastern, after opening with a 3% pre-market gain following Friday's sell-off. Chip stocks as a group rose more than 13%. Software is also higher, but the gains are uneven. Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT) and Salesforce (NYSE: CRM) are each up about 3%, while the IGV software ETF is up 4%. The biggest winners are companies that benefit from sovereign AI and a strong open-weight ecosystem. Palantir (NASDAQ: PLTR) leads at 10%, and Palantir has been one of the loudest backers of sovereign AI. Cloudflare (NYSE: NET) is up roughly 7%, and ServiceNow (NYSE: NOW) is up 5%, helped by its control tower software that guides customers between models and agentic workloads. Anthropic is lagging, since Huang has pushed open-weight models that pressure leading labs like Anthropic and OpenAI. Bleeker's takeaway: if Huang keeps backing open weight model makers, Palantir, Cloudflare and ServiceNow, up 5% to 10%, should keep outperforming the 2% to 3% gains in the rest of software.

content: Eric Bleeker, Chief Investment Officer at 24/7 Wall St., covers a broad Monday rally led by chip stocks. Chips drove the move. The iShares Semiconductor ETF (NASDAQ: SOXX) gained 12.9%, led by NVIDIA, which was up more than 30%. The iShares Expanded Tech-Software Sector ETF (Cboe: IGV) rose about 4%, so software stocks reacted far less than chip stocks. The GraniteShares 2x Long NVIDIA Daily ETF (NASDAQ: NVDL) jumped 60% but is still down nearly 50% over the past month. NVIDIA traded around $180 before Huang's ouster and hasn't recovered that level. Many stocks bouncing 20% or more today fell 20% or more at the end of last week. title: 生物药集采改革加速转向价值竞争
content: 【生物药集采改革加速转向价值竞争】近日，全国药品联盟集中带量采购（单克隆抗体类）发布第1号公告，正式启动信息申报工作。这是国内规模最大的单抗类生物药联盟集采，纳入7个单抗品种、合计15个品规，全部是临床刚需、使用体量较大的重磅药物。业内专家指出，这标志着集采改革从胰岛素这一相对单纯的生物药，迈入单抗这一高度复杂生物药的“深水区”。

title: 头部企业引领生态 应用场景多点开花城市超级智能体强力铺开

习近平指出，巴勒斯坦问题是中东问题的核心。当前中东地区紧张局势不应该转移国际社会对巴勒斯坦问题的关注。解决巴勒斯坦问题，关键在于锚定“两国方案”正确方向，推动巴以重启和谈。要秉持“巴人治巴”原则推进约旦河西岸治理和加沙战后重建，反对任何针对巴勒斯坦的占地侵权行径。国际社会要把声援巴勒斯坦的共识和承诺化为行动，推动实现加沙持久停火，保护平民安全。

习近平强调，公道自在人心，正义不容缺席。中国一贯坚定支持巴勒斯坦人民恢复民族合法权利的正义事业，将继续同国际社会所有热爱和平、坚守正义的国家一道，以国际法治为基础，以标本兼治为目标，务实推动巴勒斯坦问题早日得到全面、公正、持久解决，促进中东地区长治久安，为世界和平稳定和发展繁荣作出积极贡献。 （央视新闻）

content: 【谷子消费回归“为快乐买单”】一枚动漫角色徽章，曾经在二手市场被炒到天价，如今却被混在一堆周边产品里，按斤称重甩卖。近来，多地谷子店集中闭店，曾经人声鼎沸的二次元主题街区纷纷降温。这一系列变化表明，谷子经济正从“炒身份”的狂热，回归“买喜欢”的消费原点。

title: 乐高计划斥资近10亿欧元在葡萄牙建厂
content: 【乐高计划斥资近10亿欧元在葡萄牙建厂】乐高当地时间11月23日宣布，计划在葡萄牙埃斯塔雷雅投资约10亿欧元，建设其在欧洲的第四座工厂，以满足欧洲、中东和非洲地区不断增长的市场需求。乐高表示，新工厂将采用公司最先进的自动化技术，预计于2030年投产，全面运营后将创造1000多个就业岗位。
